g.text: Spatially explicit, agent-based eco-evolutionary model with multi-elemental stoichiometric regulation
• Lattice Size (H × W) & Max Agent Buffer
• Set Initial Organic Soil Pools to Zero
• Cell (y, x): Inorganic & Organic Soil Pools
• Agents located at continuous grid coordinates
• 2D Depthwise convolution on inorganic soil pools
• External nutrient inflow with drifting ratios
• Map local cell temperature with spatial variance
• Stochastic trigger for patch disturbance event
• Evaluate Mahalanobis distance to species center
• Apply Liebig's quota & local biomass space limits
• Add realized biomass growth to plant pool
• Recycle dead plants & turnover to organic soil
• Replenish local inorganic soil nutrient pools
• Fertile agents pay seed biomass cost
